batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c CH Gayle b DL Vettori

batting.name: BJ Haddin
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b J Syed Mohammad

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c TM Dilshan b S Aravind

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b S Aravind

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: run out (AB de Villiers, S Aravind)

balls.text: looks to scoop this one on leg stump away, but misses, they try to steal the bye, but AB relays the ball to Aravind who finds Morgan short of his ground
gets this fuller one wide of long on for a couple

YK departs in search of the forcing shot down the ground, this one was slanted across him and cut away too, he had a huge heave and ended up slicing it wide of long off where Virat ran to his left to take a neat catch
comes down the track looking to mow this one over midwicket, it is the slower one and he adjusts, one hand comes off the bat as he lifts it over midwicket
sets himself up for the big one down the ground, swings the length ball hard but on the bounce to long off, he is down on one knee Yusuf, that other knee is bothering him
makes him reach out to a wide and full one, he squeezes it down the track, Aravind gets a hand to it, but the backing up is not good and they come back for two
angles this one very wide outside off stump, not a good start
dismissively pulled away from the crease, but he finds the man at deep square leg on the bounce, Zaheer's horror spell is over for the day
tucked away wide of midwicket, and they come back for the second, YK limps through with that troublesome knee
digs this one in short and even as it climbs on YK, he swivels and flicks it away behind square leg, getting the boundary, no violence in that, just presence of mind and timing
low full toss close to off stump, and he squeezes it away to third man, good comeback from Zaheer so far this over
looked like the slower one, he wanted to pull it over midwicket, but could not get the timing on it, and gets only the single
this is what he does at the death  in ODIs. fires it in the blockhole, and Eoin can only squeeze it away in front of midwicket
Aravind has lost it this over, bowls a high full toss way outside off and Yusuf capitalises, bashing it over point and to the left of sweeper cover
no one is getting close to this one though, fuller outside off stump, and YK launches it in to the Kolkata evening, just swats it over long off, brute force

tries the slower one from back of the hand again, but it is a touch short and YK takes toll and pulls it wide of Tiwary at deep square leg, he could have got closer to it though, but let it slip through on the bounce in to the boundary
gets a short of a length ball and dabs it in front of point

Gautam falls, slower one from back of the hand, very full, Gautam makes room and tries to hammer it over extra cover, but hits it straight to the man there, it is Dilshan, fine innings from Gautam but good time for Bangalore to strike
on a length outside off from round the stumps, punched hard to long off
better line, angles this across close to off stump, pushed away in front of covers
Zaheer is adding to his horror day, bangs this one in short and wide down the leg side
dropped, a cruel thing to say, as Dilshan goes flying in the air at point to his left to a screaming drive from Gambhir off a low full toss
steered away from the crease backward of point
fired in short and wide down the leg side
tries to play the cute dab past the keeper, but cannot beat AB
Gautam is playing a delightful knock here, Zaheer pitches this one up, and Gautam eases it past extra cover
Zaheer digs this in short, Gautam skips outside the line and pulls this one to fine leg
YK takes off again, same result, the crowd picks up the ball beyond long on, this one was fuller, and Yusuf got nicely underneath it, and slammed it over long on
cut away in a flash, but can't beat point
tucked away through square leg this time
Gautam with some nifty work, gets this one down the pads, and works it with the wrists past short fine leg
pushed in front of covers, and YK hobbles through for the single
swept hard in front of square, Dilshan with some neat work in the boundary, dives and lobs the ball to tiwary who fires in the throw to Vettori
hangs back in the crease as he fires in a flat and quicker one, and tucks it in front of midwicket
lovely delivery, squares him up, pitches middle and straightens quickly, he gets an outside edge that falls in front of point

YK takes off out of nowhere, seemed a pretty okay delivery, tossed up a  bit on a length, but YK launches in to at the last moment, and once he gets hold of it, it is usually deposited over long on, which is what happened this time
comes down the track, doesn't get hold of it well, but swings it wide of deep square leg
slaps this flat one to sweeper cover off the back foot
pushes this one in the air down the ground to long off
looks to play a weak dab past slip belatedly, but misses this flat and quicker one outside off
defends this one down the track off the front foot
darted in with the angle, defended watchfully
goes hard for the cut to this one outside off, just about cut off by sweeper cover on the boundary

the big bird goes flying and comes down with the ball, Kallis rocks back to  a shortish one and tries to hammer it over extra cover, doesn't time it that well, and Gayle at short extra cover goes leaping to his left, went very fast for the big man he is, and took the screamer cleanly
Gautam to dance down the track, and now he clips a full one in front of square leg
now Gautam gets the single, shortish and he slogs it away to deep midwicket
this time he stays back and eases this one for a single to long on
stumping chance missed, Kallis rushed out, flailed wildly at a flat one, missed but the keeper fluffed the take
hangs in the crease and tucks this one behind square
Gautam skips out, sees he is too close to the pitch of a flighted one, and short-arm jabs this one down the ground in the air and in to the boundary
comes slowly off the wicket, he makes room and hits it to sweeper cover
can't get it away again, makes room outside leg, Gayle sees that and fires in a full toss on the pads, Gautam tries to sweep it away but finds short fine leg
Gautam tries the late dab to a shortish one, finds short third man in the way
driven with the turn to long on this time
skips down the track, and flicks a fuller one on the pads, but right to short fine leg
full toss low on leg stump, eased away to long on along the ground
digs this one in short as he sees him charging out, swatted away to long on in the end

Gautam with that inside out loft over extra cover, makes room to a fuller one, and times the swing perfectly, gets four in the gap between sweeper cover and long off, Zaheer's nightmare is not over yet
eases this one down the ground to long on
this time Gautam hangs back beside the line of this one outside off and steers it to third man
kicks up a bit from a length outside off, he is surprised and stabs it away to third man
waits for an instant and drives through extra cover now, Pujara at sweeper cover puts it a desperate dive and saves  arun
and right away, is dispatched over midwicket for four, angled in on a length on the pads, and Gautam launches in to it
good delivery, flighted again, not as much as the previous one, and goes straight on outside off, he mistimes the cut to point
tossed up very slowly, KAllis makes room outside leg, and launches it with a big swing over extra cover
loud shout for leg-before, Kallis plays for the turn, this one goes straight to strike him on the pads, turned down  by the umpre, would have hit leg, replays show
steered behind point for a single
comes out and flicks this one, but finds Gayle in the way at shortish midwicket
tosses this one down the leg side
tossed up and goes straight on, he drives and gets an inside edge backward of square leg
comes out, takes this one on the full and drives but straight to extra cover
turns in and he flicks it past square leg
driven off the front foot to extra cover
high full toss, too high, he swats it away to long on, it is a no-ball as well
pushed away off the back foot in front of point
fires it in full with a seven-step run-up, Gambhir skips out and flicks through midwicket
full from wide of the crease, pushed away in front of square leg
pushed with soft hands in front of point, and Gambhir rushes for the single
flat, fast and short, Gambhir quickly picks it and pulls it past midwicket, but there is a man in the deep there
flighted around off, he comes forward and picks up the single to long off with the forcing drive
tucked away off the pads backward of square leg
tossed up full, he gets close to the pitch and squeezes it back to Vettori
flat on the stumps, tries to dab it away but can't beat the keeper
steered off the back foot to third man
Gambhir gets four, scythes hard across the line of a length ball angled in, beats midwicket, and comfortably beats long on
low full toss, he drives it hard in the ground past the bowler
cuts in from round the stumps, he waits and dabs it late towards short third man
gets forward and drives a length ball to sweeper cover, there is hardly any pace off the pitch
clipped away off the pads from a fuller length to deep square leg
misfield in covers, driven hard off the front foot, but it slips through the fielder's hands
skips down the track, Dilshan follow him, and he gets it on the leg side off the pads
pushed away on the off side
flat and fast, but touch short, and he cannot the cut past cover
driven down the ground with the turn to long on
drops it short, and he rocks back to cut it wide of sweeper cover
skips outside the line of one darted in from round the wicket, and earns a wide
fires in another one flat, pushed back hurriedly to the bowler, he has conceded 2 runs in 2 overs, amid all the carnage at the other end

gets reward for some tight bowling, tossed this one up a bit, Haddin backed away a touch and went for the big lofted shot over mid off from the crease, this one turned a bit, and he got the edge that settled safely in to the hands of Virat at point
back of a length, he cannot get the punch past extra cover
goes deep in the crease to work this one away in front of midwicket
another one angled in flat, pushed back down the track
slanted in from wide of the crease, pushed back to the bowler
drops it short, and he takes toll, shuffles outside the line, lets it turn in and hammers it over square leg for a boundary
swatted away past midwicket for another single
gets him to drive outside off, tossed up just a bit, he cannot beat the infield though
fuller this time, nothing to work with, so HAddin settles for the single to long on
darted in flat and turning in a touch, punches for a single to long on
shortish and turning down leg, helped away in front of square leg, there is a man on the boundary
slanted in with the arm, he goes back to cut, but cannot time it past point
waits in the crease and pushes out this one to backward point
angles this in, and he picks it away for a single in front of square leg
goes back to punch a back of a length ball, but cannot beat cover
flatter on the stumps, played out on the leg side
tossed up outside off, pushed away off the front foot
another boundary, Bangalore will wish they are anywhere expect Eden at the moment, dabs a length ball going across him very late, and it runs away past short third man
lovely shot from Haddin, stands in the crease and picks this length ball up with a straight swing, and the ball is collected from somewhere beyond the long on boundary
Haddin goes reaching out to this one outside off and just gets it in the air over extra cover who runs towards it but it falls just over his shoulder
has him pushing at one that angles across him from a fuller length, thick edge to  third man
walks down the wicket, and flicks this one off his pads, good work from Zaheer running to his left at fine leg
starts off on a tight length on the stumps, pushed away by Haddin
gets an inside edge as he tries to drive this one pitched up, ball rolls towards mid on, Zaheer's nightmare over is over
Zaheer would want to quickly forget this over, when it ends that is, this one is down the pads, and Kallis happily clips it through square leg for another boundary
this one is slanted wide outside off, Kallis reaches out, and throws his bat at it, and gets the ball over covers for a boundary
better from Zaheer, pushed away off the front foot
and out of nowhere arrives one that zips back in from a length, catching Kallis on the pads and goes to the keeper, they appeal for leg before, not given, ball would have just shaved off stump
the horror start for Zaheer continues, this time he pitches it back of a length way outside off and it moves further away, lot of movement around but Zaheer is still to control it
makes no difference, slants it in on a length but it goes wide down leg
poorer delivery from Zaheer, Kallis had no chance to tickle or do anything with it, pitches outside leg and moves further down the leg side, no chance for the keeper as well
starts off with a poor delivery on the pads, Kallis casually tickles it fine and gets four
Gayle gets the century, smiles broadly and hugs Virat, it was short and wide, and he hammered it over covers on one leg in cavalier fashion
flights this one on leg stump, Virat kills it in forward defence, all set up for Gayle's big one next over
Iqbal does a Randiv, can't say whether it was intentional, fires this one wide down the leg side
tosses this one invitingly, Kohli has shut shop for the day, textbook forward defence from him
and now is beaten as he pushes half-forward outside off
now he pushes this one in to the off side
gets hit on the pads as Iqbal darts this one in, not given
Virat gets four, sheepishly realises what has happened as Gayle wears a smile at the other end, it was a terrible half-tracker, and he swatted it to the wide long on boundary
goes for the forcing shot through covers to one going across and is beaten, he will have to wait
plays it safe, pushes out a length ball towards covers
punched off the back foot down to long off, Gayle on strike again, can he do it this time?
gets a single with a nudge in front of square leg, two more to go
turns another fuller one to long on to bring Gayle on strike
lovely work from Virat, uses the wrists ti flick a fuller one from outside off stump through midwicket, the timing is so good that it beats both deep midwicket and long on
slaps a fuller one with the turn to long off
nudges a low full toss to deep square leg
full toss, hit down the track to the bowler, Abdulla manages to stop it and does some damage to his hand
Gayle continues to find the boundary, this one is dropped short and he cuts it in front of point, and sweeper cover is nowhere in sight, on to 96 now
tossed up full down leg, he turns it to short fine leg
drives this one down to long off
now hangs back and steers a short and wide one to third man
maximum this time, what a shot, full outside off stump, he puts front foot out and goes through with the swing with a big followthrough, and smokes it all the way over extra cover
Virat piles on the misery for Kolkata, gets a full on the pads and flicks it wide of mid on, class

tries the yorker but gets it full down the leg side, Haddin sees Gayle outside the crease and hits the stumps, Gayle had his bat down till then, as the ball ricocheted, Virat pushed Gayle for the run, Gayle hobbled through, he is looking a bit knackered
slower bouncer from Balaji, Virat adjusts as it gets big on him, and pulls it in to the ground towards deep midwicket for a single
angles in the full ball, Virat drives it to mid on
good ball from Balaji, yorker on the stumps, Gayle manages to get an inside edge as he stands motionless in the crease, that is what led to the lbw appeal being turned down
bangs this one in short around leg stump, Virat tries to hook it away but abandons the shot in the end
this time Virat gets a couple with a steer wide of third man
just pushes at a full and wide ball outside off, and it flies past point, YK somehow manages to stop it rushing from third man, fumbles on the first attempt but recovers to save the boundary
shuffles and flicks a length ball in front of square leg
full and wide outside off, eased away off the front foot to sweeper cover, easy on the eye
pushes a length ball going across him towards mid off
clips a full ball off the toes, this time wide of midwicket
emphatic and classy clip off the pads from Virat, but finds midwicket
worked away off then hip behind square leg
poor delivery, and poorer, considering it is to Gayle in this mood, full toss around off, he just stands and slaps it past the hapless men at mid off and extra cover
Balaji bangs in the bouncer, but it is a  foot outside leg
shuffles and whips a short of a length ball wide of midwicket

goes through Dilshan this time, Eden Gardens finds its voice, this one nipped back in a shade from a length, Dilshan had already set himself up for the forcing slap-drive of his, but the ball beat his swing and took out off stump
almost casually Gayle takes a step out and belts a length ball past Dilshan who eagerly shouts "two, two" again, but Gayle has hit it so well they get four
stands tall and pushes a straight delivery straighter down the track, "two, two" shots Dilshan, and gets it comfortably
he is beaten, he is beaten, stop the press, looks to steer one outside off and misses
this is too much, Kolkata have nowhere to hide, shuffles and mows this one over deep square leg
Gayle goes through extra cover this time, hangs back to a very full one and drives it past extra cover
scythed away through midwicket for a single
tossed up slowly around off and moving away, willing the big man to launch in to it, but he has had enough for the over, and quietly dabs it away, Gayle Mark II this one is, selectively murderous
Dilshan skips out and swings a fuller one away to long on
gets the single in front of extra cover now
now he decides to push this one away on the off side
more carnage from the big fella, gets too much underneath this fuller one and ends up lofting it very high but he is so powerful that even the mishit carries well over the straight boundary
tosses up this one from round the stumps, Gayle thinks for an instant before slapping it over long on dismissively
wants to belt this fuller one past extra cover but again hits it to the fielder
Dilshan is playing it smartly, looks to give Gayle the strike with a dab past point, cannot beat the man
this one is back of a length, Gayle goes back to push it down to long off
cut away off the back foot to sweeper cover
cuts away from leg stump slowly, Gayle stays in the crease and punches it to long off
goes deep in the crease and works this one away through midwicket
he shows he wants to take his team home himself, defending a tossed up ball on the off side

this one is hammered alright, Yusuf serves up a short delivery that sits up and Gayle pulls it high over deep midwicket, oh you got to feel for the bowler against this brutal bully, maybe not, that was a poor ball, 50 up for Gayle by the way
neat work from Gayle, no hammering this time, walks across the stumps and helps it from middle stumps fine on the leg side
played out towards mid on this time
defended towards covers this time
smoked! rocks back and hammers a shortish one past a diving Gautam at extra cover
pushed away in front of covers for a single, this is what Bangalore were missing so far this season, a start
another one, this one is over deep square leg, he mows another flatter one on one knee, and gets the connection brutally right
fires this one across the left-hander, he plays it away close to the pitch on the off side
the big bird has taken off, Gayle goes down on one knee and slogs a flat and fuller delivery over deep midwicket and miles in to the crowd
looks to heave another one over midwicket, does not time it well, and the inside edge rolls to short fine leg
waits for it to turn away and swats it away ti sweeper cover
fires this one in flat and short, Gayle shuffles and pushes it back to Yusuf
tossed up from round the stump, pushed away off the front foot again
pushed away in to the off side
controls the pull to the right of midwicket, checking his followthrough and picking up the single
pushed away off the front foot in front of extra cover
helped away off the pads to short fine leg who fumbles to allow the single
heaved away wide of deep midwicket for a boundary, Kolkata need a wicket somehow
Gayle comes out now but is beaten in flight, takes it on the pads, appeal for lbw by Shakib, and some confusion between the batsmen as the ball rolls towards short third man
punches in the air, but there is no one at mid off, long off fields
charges out, is not close to the length ball but adjusts to swat it over midwicket
turns in on the pads slowly, worked away in front of midwicket
cut away towards covers for a single
angled across the batsman who pushes in front of extra cover for a single

almost another boundary, he bowls it back of a lenth wide outside off and Gayle creams it off the back foot, but extra cover is in the way and fires in the throw, direct hit would have had him in trouble
another one, this one goes all the way, Gayle gets a length ball and swats it over wide long on disdainfully
dispatched! Gayle uses the angle on this one very well, hangs back in the crease and picks it through square leg off his pads
104.8 kph short one, Dilshan picked up the length and was in to the pull very early, but adjusted to pick up a single through square leg
length ball angled in, tucked away off the pads through midwicket
lovely shot from the Sri Lanka captain, stays in the crease, Balaji offers him width outside off, and he cuts it past point and too quick for Yusuf at third man
Balaji is doing a Zaheer here, now angles this one on a length and wide down leg
takes a step out and chips in the air, but it falls short of deep midwicket

one more full toss from Balaji, and Gayle dismissively eases it past the non-striker's stumps for a boundary, 'eases' is relative of course compared to the ferocious thumps he gives normally to such balls
tries to pull this one which is not short at all, gets an inside edge on the leg side
bowls a full toss middle and leg, and Dilshan likes it, swinging it over midwicket for a boundary
now Balaji beats Dilshan who has a big go outside off stump to one that moves away from a length
starts and finishes the over with a swing-and-miss outside off stump, Unadkat gives Gayle the stare, oh boy
poor delivery, short of a length on the pads, but Dilshan helps it straight to short fine leg who fumbles to allow the single
takes a step out to cream it away down the ground, but it comes slowly off the pitch and he adjusts to push it away on the off side
fuller one, driven hard towards mid on
tucked away off the pads towards square leg
bowls this one full outside off, making him go for the drive and beating him as the ball zips away

takes on the short one angled in to him, swivels and pulls hard, carries to a diving Morgan at deep square leg, but bursts through his left hand in to the boundary, technically  a drop, but that is because Morgan managed to get a hand to it
angles in from a length now, he stays back and pushes in front of cover
this one moves away, lovely seam position from Balaji, Dilshan swung at it from the crease and is beaten
the Balaji slow bouncer arrives outside off, Dilshan can't do much with the lack of pace on it, and hits it to point
this one swerves in a bit from a length, Gayle uncertainly pushes forward and gets an inside edge towards midwicket
good delivery to start off, very full on middle and leg, he squeezes it away towards extra cover
gets another boundary, Bangalore are away, skips out and lifts it high over mid off, just bounces inside the boundary
goes for the sweep again, this one is outside off, goes straight and he misses
pays the price for being on leg stump this time, Dilshan shuffles outside the line and sweeps him over square leg
quicker one played out to midwicket
works it away off the hip to square leg
pushes this one through, turned away towards mid on
